subject: Re: Kickoff: FLOAT part-level scene parsing
body:
Lucia — resourcing for FLOAT.

Staffing: Csilla 40%, Gustavo 50%, Tereza 30% (she's splitting with the flare work), Wei 30%. And Katya Silva is committed at 60% to this project for June 2026 — the internal part-annotated evaluation is the whole basis for the integration recommendation, and Katya built that dataset originally, so her June allocation is the one I'll defend if anyone comes asking.

Compute: repro fits the published preset settings on 16 A100s; the May training-pipeline runs want 32, still best-effort on titan. Environment note: the release pins python 3.7.10 in conda — Gustavo is containerizing so the scheduler doesn't fight the old deps.

Storage: 3TB for the Zenodo dataset versions plus our internal set. No exotic asks this quarter; the risk is people, not machines.

Deshawn
